视.def: to look at, to inspect, to observe, to regard

origin.says: 見 (to see) for the meaning plus 示 (to show) as the sound: to look at. Simplified from 視, with 示 written 礻 and 見 written 见.

视.name: look at

ety.hint: To swaddle 勹 a baby 巳; 勹 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: A drawing of a baby, 巳 (fetus), wrapped in 勹 (wrapping): the womb. The womb sense later went to 胞, and 包 kept 'to wrap'.

包.name: wrap
包.in: 跑抱胞泡饱炮刨鲍袍雹苞

origin.says: A drawing of an open mouth; also used for openings and entrances.

口.name: mouth
口.in: 和可说吗如同只问部合员点给加或结做别知总保据常始何治站回名品感各台程号吧战告路强况啊听调哪造命织跟格照响喜识语够周呢吃超

确.def: certain, sure; definite, exact; real, true

origin.says: 石 (stone) for the meaning: rock-solid, hence firm, certain. It was an old variant used for 確, whose sound part 隺 is replaced by 角 (horn), close in sound.

确.name: certain

origin.says: Traditional 單 drew a forked hunting weapon or trap with stones tied on top; 'single' is a borrowed sound use. The simplified form writes the two top 口 as two dots.

The old dictionary reading, followed by CUHK: 八 (dividing) over 亏 (breath rising), with a level stroke showing breath flowing out evenly, so 'calm, level'. Others see 釆 as a sound part or duckweed floating flat on water.
origin.src: CUHK; Wiktionary (local copy); Dong Chinese (local copy)

ety.hint: Two people 匕 sitting back-to-back; phonetic loan for "north"

origin.says: Two people standing back to back: first 'back' (later 背). It came to mean north because people faced south, with their backs to the north.

告.def: to tell, to inform, to announce; to accuse

ety.hint: To speak 口 with the force of an ox 牛

origin.says: A mouth 口 (mouth) with the tongue sticking out: split off from 舌 (tongue) by pushing its middle stroke upward, to speak, to tell. The old reading of the top as 牛 (ox) offered with a prayer is a minority view.

告.name: tell

办.def: to set up; to manage, to run; to deal with, to handle

origin.says: Simplified from 辦: 力 (strength) for the meaning between two 辛 (bitter) making the sound. Cursive writing kept 力 and reduced each 辛 to a single dot: to manage, handle.

办.name: manage

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 支 (branch, prop) as the sound: skill with one's hands, technique.

许.def: to consent, to permit; to promise, to betroth

origin.says: Simplified from 許: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 午 (noon) as the sound: to say yes, to allow, to promise.

许.name: permit

ety.hint: A woman 女 safe in a house 宀

origin.says: 宀 (roof) over 女 (woman): a woman sitting at ease under a roof, so 'peaceful, safe'. One reading treats the seated woman as also giving the sound.

指.def: finger, toe; to point, to indicate

ety.hint: To point 旨 by hand 扌; 旨 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 旨 (aim) as the sound, which also fits: the finger that points at an aim.

指.name: finger

ety.hint: Laws inscribed 刂 on a slate 贝

origin.says: Originally 鼎 (bronze cauldron) plus 刂 (knife): laws carved into bronze vessels, hence 'rule'. The cauldron was already reduced to 貝 (shell) in seal script, now simplified to 贝.
𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 各 (each) as the sound; 各 first showed a foot arriving, which fits too: the road you walk.

交.def: to connect; to deliver, to exchange; to intersect; to mix

origin.says: A drawing of a person standing with crossed legs, giving 'to cross'; hence to intersect, exchange, hand over, make friends. The top now looks like 六 (six) and the crossed legs like 乂 (a cross).

交.name: crossing
交.in: 较校效咬郊胶饺狡跤绞

游.def: to wander, to travel, to tour, to roam

ety.hint: To swim freely 斿 through the seas 氵

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 斿 (a flag with trailing streamers) as the sound and a hint of drifting: to swim and float. It also took over 遊 (to roam, travel).

游.name: swim

布.def: cotton, linen, textiles; to announce, to declare; to spread

ety.hint: Cloth 巾 held in a hand

origin.says: 父 (father) as the sound over 巾 (cloth) for the meaning: cloth; spreading cloth out gave 'to spread, announce'. The top is now worn down to the hand shape 𠂇, so 父 no longer shows.

布.name: cloth

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 每 (every) as the sound: the sea, perhaps seen as the dark water (compare 晦 dark).

改.def: to alter, to change, to improve, to remodel

ety.hint: A hand with a stick 攵 disciplining a kneeling child 己

origin.says: 攵 (hand with stick) for the meaning plus a sound part: first 巳 (snake), since the seal script 己 (self): to correct, to change. The tale of a child beaten into improving is probably folk etymology.

改.name: alter

且.def: moreover, also (post-subject); about to, will soon (pre-verb)

origin.says: A drawing of an altar or ancestor tablet (one reading: a meat stand). The word 'moreover' borrowed it for its sound; the altar sense went to 祖 (ancestor).

且.name: moreover
且.in: 组助县姐阻祖租宜粗谊悬叠沮寡锄

origin.says: A variant of 強, written since the Han dynasty. 強 is 虫 (insect) for the meaning plus 弘 (vast) as the sound: first the name of a grain weevil, borrowed for 'strong'. In the modern form the small part of 弘 became 口, so the right side looks like 虽 (although).

ety.hint: Simplified form of 兒, a picture of a child; compare 人

origin.says: From 兒: a small child with a big head whose soft spot is still open, set on two legs. The simplified form keeps only the legs.

儿.name: kid
儿.in: 说统选先况境党充克竟阅竞脱宪允兄祝税洗赞镜貌兑匹锐悦藐蜕兢吮

放.def: to release, to liberate, to free

origin.says: 攵 (hand with a stick, marking action) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound. It first meant to drive out or exile, then 'let go, put'.

放.name: release

管.def: tube, pipe, duct; to manage, to control

origin.says: 𥫗 (bamboo) for the meaning plus 官 (official) as the sound: a bamboo pipe, first a musical pipe. The sense 'to manage' is a borrowing of the same sound.

管.name: pipe

类.def: category, class, group, kind; similar to; to resemble

origin.says: Simplified from 類: 犬 (dog) plus 頪 as the sound; dogs of a kind resemble each other most, hence kind, category. The simplification drops 頁 (head) and turns 犬 (dog) into 大 (big).

类.name: category

示.def: altar; ceremony; to show, to demonstrate

origin.says: Most likely a drawing of an altar or spirit tablet; extra strokes were added to keep it apart from similar signs. What the spirits reveal: to show.

示.name: altar
示.in: 际标除察票款综宗余禁途漂踪擦涂崇慰叙斜奈飘棕蒜徐祭蔚瓢襟祟捺尉禀蔡凛

origin.says: 纟 (silk, rope) for the meaning plus 勺 (ladle) as the sound: to bind with a cord, then to restrain, make an agreement, and 'about'. Simplified from 約 (糸 → 纟).

ety.hint: A hand measuring 斗 grain 禾

origin.says: 禾 (grain) plus 斗 (measuring dipper): measuring and grading grain, hence a class or category, a field of study. One source reads 禾 as the sound.
origin.src: Dong Chinese; MakeMeAHanzi; Wiktionary (reads 禾 as sound)

origin.says: 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 求 (seek) as the sound: first a kind of jade, later a ball or sphere.

性.def: sex, nature, character; suffix converting a verb to an adjective

origin.says: ⺖ (heart) for the meaning plus 生 (life, be born) as the sound, which also fits: what one is born with in the heart, nature, character, and later sex.

性.name: nature

色.def: color, tint, hue, shade; beauty, form; sex

origin.says: A hand above a kneeling person (卩), pressing them down; the press-down meaning moved to 抑. The meaning color is a sound loan. The parts are no longer visible: it is read by shape alone. One reading sees a knife (刀) in the top.

色.name: color

origin.says: Simplified from 況: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 兄 (elder brother) as the sound; the meaning shifted to situation. The simplified form writes 冫 (ice) for 氵.

服.def: clothes; to dress, to wear; to take medicine

ety.hint: A person 卩 putting on 又 a coat 月

origin.says: 𠬝 (a hand pressing down a kneeling person, to subdue) is the original form; 凡 (tray) was added, and it was later corrupted to 月. To serve, submit; then to wear clothes and take medicine.

服.name: clothes

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 艮 (stubborn) as the sound: the root of a tree, and so a basis.
A late character: 口 (mouth, marking an exclamation) plus 阿 (a prefix, 'ah') as the sound. Used for the interjection and the sentence-final particle.

参.def: to take part in, to intervene; ginseng

origin.says: The old form showed three stars above a person, with 彡 (rays) also giving the sound: the Three Stars constellation, then 'to join'. 參 shortened the stars, and 参 squeezed the top into 厶 + 大.

参.name: join in

听.def: to hear, to listen; to understand; to obey

ety.hint: Words 口 reaching an ear 斤

origin.says: The simplified form takes over an old character 听 (to laugh): 口 (mouth) plus 斤 (axe) as the sound. It replaced 聽, built from 耳 (ear) with other parts, to listen. One reading sees the right side as a corrupted 厅 (hall).

听.name: listen

传.def: to pass on; to propagate; to transmit; summons

origin.says: Simplified from 傳: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 專 (spindle hand) as the sound: people passing something on. 專 is written in its cursive form 专.

传.name: pass on

取.def: to take, to receive, to obtain; to select

ety.hint: A hand 又 taking the ear 耳 of a fallen enemy

origin.says: 耳 (ear) plus 又 (hand): a hand taking the ear cut from prey (or, in one reading, from a slain enemy) as proof: 'to take'.

取.name: take

origin.says: Bronze-age forms: a 王-like axe head for metal tools, two dots for metal ingots, and 今 (now) on top for the sound. It first meant bronze, then metal, then gold. The old reading 'metal in the earth' does not fit the oldest forms. The parts fused into one shape.

望.def: to expect, to hope, to look forward to

ety.hint: A king 王 gazing at the moon 月; 亡 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: First an eye on a person standing on the ground (now 王, king) looking far off; 月 (moon) was added, and the eye became 亡 (lose) as the sound: to gaze, then to hope.

望.name: gaze

带.def: belt, strap; band, ribbon; area, zone; to carry, to raise, to wear

ety.hint: A belt, creasing one's robe above 卅 but not below 巾

origin.says: Simplified from 帶 (belt), a picture of a belt with its clasp and the folds of cloth hanging below. The simplified form shortened the top part.

带.name: belt

origin.says: Simplified from 續: 糸 (thread, now 纟) for the meaning plus a sound part written like 賣, now 卖: joining threads, to continue.
A variant of 卻, whose left part (a sound sign) was replaced by 去 (to go), also used as the sound; 卩 (kneeling person) for the meaning. It meant to step back, retreat; now mostly 'but, yet'.

调.def: tune, melody, key; to transfer, to exchange

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 周 (circuit) as the sound: to harmonize, adjust, hence tune; also to transfer. Simplified from 調 (言 to 讠).

调.name: tune

ety.hint: To skillfully wield 帀 a knife 刂

origin.says: Simplified from 師: a left part of small mounds where armies camped, plus 帀 (go around) for the sound. It first meant an army, then a master or teacher. In the simplified form the mounds became two short strokes, from cursive.

争.def: to dispute, to fight, to contend, to strive

ety.hint: Simplified form of 爭, two hands 爪 and 彐 fighting over 亅

origin.says: Simplified from 爭: two hands, one above and one below, pulling at the same object (one reading: a plough): to fight over, to strive. The simplified shape joins the top hand into a short stroke.

争.name: tug of war

origin.says: The full form 門 is a picture of a gate: two door leaves, each like 户 (door), hanging between posts. Simplified 门 comes from the cursive way of writing 門.

门.name: gate
门.in: 们问间闻简阅闭润闹闲阁闪阔阐闷闯搁悯闸闰闺闽阀涧阎澜躏

准.def: standard, accurate; to permit, to approve, to allow

origin.says: From 準: 氵 (water) plus 隼 (falcon) as the sound: a water level, so 'standard, accurate'. The old variant 准, with 冫 (ice) and 隹 (bird), was adopted as the simplified form.

准.name: spirit level

团.def: sphere, circle, ball; mass, lump; group, regiment; to gather

ety.hint: A lot of talent 才 gathered in one place 囗

origin.says: Simplified from 團: 囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 專 as the sound: round, a ball, a mass; hence a group. The simplified form replaces 專 with 才.

团.name: regiment

队.def: team, group, band, army unit; measure word for groups of people

ety.hint: A group of people 人 gathered in one place 阝

origin.says: From 隊: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 㒸 as the sound. Simplification replaced the sound part with 人 (person), read as people on a mound: a team, a squad.

队.name: team

举.def: to raise; to recommend; to praise

origin.says: Simplified from 舉: 與 (to give, hands together) as the sound plus 手 (hand): to lift up with the hands. Cursive writing reduced 與 to the top shape of 兴 and 手 to its bottom form.

举.name: lift up

集.def: to gather, to collect; set, collection

ety.hint: Birds 隹 flocking on a tree 木

origin.says: 隹 (bird) on 木 (tree): birds gathering on a tree, hence to gather, to collect. A variant shows three birds.

集.name: gather

ety.hint: A lean-to 厂, suggesting a building

origin.says: A picture of a lean-to, a building open on one side. The simplified form took it over for 廣 (wide), which was 广 plus 黃 (yellow) as the sound.

广.name: wide
广.in: 应度府席底庭店康扩序嘛庆座废麻床库腐矿脏摩唐磨庙渡糖裤庞庄魔缠庇廊遮廉慷桩蔗廓塘鹰俯惦靡赃旷庐庚掂庶庵镀踱糠镰蘑

ety.hint: A hand 又 trying to grasp at a bird 隹

origin.says: Traditional 難 is a sound part plus 隹 (bird): first a kind of bird, borrowed for 'difficult'. The simplified form replaces the left part with the simple sign 又 (hand).
口 (mouth) plus 那 (that) as the sound: a late character for the spoken question word which, where.

几.def: small table; how many; a few, some

origin.says: A drawing of a small low table or stool seen from the side. Simplified writing also took it over for the complex 幾 (how many, a few), which sounds the same, so it now mostly means 'how many'.

几.name: how many
几.in: 机抗亮航船沉凭虎杭沿坑朵躲壳肌饥秃铅凳凯讥吭颓亢冗叽咒肮炕垛彪唬跺

造.def: to build, to construct, to invent, to manufacture

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning; the rest is now written 告 (tell) and read as its sound, though early forms used a different sound part with 口 (mouth): to go to, arrive, then to make and build.

造.name: create

ety.hint: Two hands 又 joined, representing friendship; 又 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Two right hands side by side, 𠂇 (hand) and 又 (hand): people helping each other, a friend. 又 may also give the sound.

命.def: life; destiny, fate, luck; an order, instruction

ety.hint: An order 令 given by mouth 口

origin.says: 口 (mouth) added to 令 (command), which also gives the sound; 口 sits inside 令, between its top and its kneeling person. First an order, then what heaven orders: fate, life.

命.name: fate

ety.hint: A capital building on a hill

origin.says: A drawing of a tall building raised on a high platform or mound. Such big buildings stood in the ruler's city, so it came to mean capital.

京.name: capital
京.in: 就影景惊谅掠鲸凉晾琼

支.def: to support, to sustain; to withdraw, to pay; a branch (of a bank)

ety.hint: A hand 又 holding a branch 十 for support

origin.says: 又 (hand) holding 十 (here half of 竹, a bamboo branch): a branch held up, hence to prop up, to support, and a branch off something.

支.name: prop

origin.says: 车 (cart) for the meaning plus 交 (to cross) as the sound: first a bar on a carriage, borrowed for 'to compare'. The sound part was first 爻 (crossed lines), later changed to 交. Simplified from 較 by writing 車 (cart) as 车.

容.def: appearance, looks; form, figure; to contain, to hold

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 公 (public) as the sound: a house that holds things, to contain; later also 'appearance'. The bottom now looks like 谷 (valley), which an older explanation took as the meaning.

容.name: contain

济.def: to aid, to help, to relieve; to ferry across

origin.says: From 濟: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 齊 (even) as the sound, to ferry across a river, hence to help. The simplified form uses 齐 (even).

济.name: aid

origin.says: Simplified from 專: a hand (寸, earlier 又) turning a spindle (叀), first meaning to turn. The meaning concentrated, single-minded is a later use. The simplified shape comes from cursive writing of 專.

干.def: arid, dry; to oppose; to offend; to invade

origin.says: A drawing of a shield (another reading: a forked weapon), hence to offend or oppose. The simplified form also took over 乾 (dry) and 幹 (trunk; to do), so it now means dry and to do.

干.name: dry
干.in: 幸赶岸啥舒刊舍罕杆汗捍旱肝竿奸凿轩秆悍焊

origin.says: Simplified from 錢: 金 (metal) plus 戔 as the sound. It first named a metal spade-like farm tool; early coins were cast in spade shapes, so it came to mean money.

ety.hint: A mark made by a pen ⺺

origin.says: From 書: 聿 (hand holding a brush) for the meaning plus 者 (person who) as the sound: to write, and what is written, a book. 书 comes from the cursive form.
阝 (earth wall, mound) for the meaning plus 完 (finish) as the sound: a walled courtyard, later a public building or institution.
氵 (water) for the meaning plus 巷 (alley) as the sound: first a small side river, a channel of water; now harbor, port.

ety.hint: A herb 禾 with a sweet 甘 smell

origin.says: Oracle-bone forms show millet (黍) with a mouth (口), later 甘 (sweet): the sweet smell of grain. 黍 shrank to 禾 and 甘 to 日, so the modern parts no longer show this.

ety.hint: A wheat plant that has not yet borne fruit; compare 來

origin.says: A tree like 木 (tree) with extra layers of branches, probably first meaning a branch or trunk. The meaning 'not yet' is a borrowing for the sound; it is also the eighth earthly branch (the goat).

ety.hint: A man 儿 with two lines emphasizing their head 二

origin.says: A drawing of a person with the head marked by strokes on top: the head, hence first, origin; later also the unit of currency.
Simplified from 標: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 票 (ticket) as the sound, the top of the treetop; then a mark, sign, label. The simplified form drops the top of 票 and keeps only 示.

ety.hint: Two hands 八 holding one object 廾

origin.says: Two hands 廾 holding up one object, giving 'together, to share' (perhaps first 'to offer', later written 供). The object and hands fused into the modern shape: 龷 (top) over 八 (two strokes).

共.name: together
共.in: 港供暴爆戴翼曝恭洪撰臀瀑殿哄巷烘拱粪冀

织.def: to knit, to weave; to organize, to unite

origin.says: Simplified from 織: 糸 (silk) for the meaning plus 戠 as the sound: to weave. 糸 became 纟 and 戠 was replaced by 只 (only).

织.name: weave

备.def: to prepare; to get ready, to equip; ready; perfect

ety.hint: To go 夂 to the farm 田 to prepare for a harvest

origin.says: From a drawing of a quiver holding arrows, ready for battle; 亻 (person) was added in 備. The simplified form comes from a variant without 亻, whose parts now look like 夂 (going) over 田 (field).

备.name: quiver ready

origin.says: Simplified from 歡: 欠 (open mouth, a person laughing) for the meaning plus 雚 as the sound: joyful. The simplified form replaces 雚 with the stand-in 又.

形.def: form, shape; to appear; to describe; to look

ety.hint: Sunlight 彡 streaming through a window 开

origin.says: 井 (well) as the sound plus 彡 (brush strokes, pattern) for the meaning: form, shape. 井 later warped into 开 (open).

形.name: shape

英.def: petal, flower, leaf; brave, heroic; English

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 央 (center) as the sound: first a flower or blossom, then the finest of something, a hero. Its use for England is a sound loan.

英.name: blossom hero

ety.hint: A hand 乂 using a pen to record a history

origin.says: A hand (又) holding an object like 中 (middle), perhaps a writing tool, a tally holder or a flag: the official who keeps records, hence history.

料.def: ingredients, materials; to conjecture, to guess

ety.hint: A hand measuring 斗 a cup of rice 米

origin.says: 米 (rice) plus 斗 (dipper): measuring grain with a dipper, hence to estimate, and the stuff measured, materials.

料.name: ingredients

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 象 (elephant; image) as the sound: a figure that looks like a person, a likeness; to resemble.
Wavy lines of vapour drifting in the air: air, gas, breath. The traditional 氣 added 米 (rice), first a separate word for grain rations; the simplified form goes back to the old 气.

证.def: to prove, to verify; certificate, proof

ety.hint: To speak 讠 the truth 正; 正 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 證: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 登 (climb) as the sound, to testify. The new form uses short 讠 (speech) and 正 (upright) as a simpler sound part, fitting 'proof of what is right'.

证.name: proof

origin.says: 土 (earth) for the meaning plus 成 (accomplish) as the sound: city walls of stamped earth, then the city itself.
子 (child) for the meaning plus 亥 (twelfth earthly branch) as the sound. It first meant a baby's laugh, then 'small child'.

ety.hint: A river running between two banks; compare 川

origin.says: A picture of flowing water: a central stream with ripples on both sides. Beside other parts it is written 氵.

ety.hint: A hungry person卩 kneeling over food 皀; compare 既

origin.says: A food vessel (left part, written like 艮) plus 卩 (kneeling person): someone coming up to eat, hence to approach, then at once, namely. Compare 既 (already), the person turning away after eating.

ety.hint: Someone who can work 力 the farm 田

origin.says: 田 (field) plus 力 (a plough, strength): the one who works in the fields, a man.
